description: Contours des écluses et des déversoirs is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vlaamse Waterweg NV. Contours of locks and weirs. Coverage: Vlaamse Waterweg NV. The portal shows the English title as "Contours of locks and weirs" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vlaamse Waterweg NV. Its keywords include binnenwatervervoer, europees, Contours of locks and dams, vervoersnetwerken. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
